reason: Adds chat tools for text-to-image generation and image editing through a configured third-party OpenAI Images-compatible API, with local reference-image input and generated-image saving.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的第三方 OpenAI Images 兼容接口，在聊天中生成和编辑图片，并支持使用本地参考图及保存生成结果。
summaries.en: Generates and edits images in chat through a configured third-party OpenAI Images-compatible API, with support for local reference images and saving generated results.

capabilities: Calls a configured third-party OpenAI Images-compatible API for text-to-image generation and image editing
Accepts local PNG, JPEG, and WebP reference images for editing
Writes generated images to the conversation and the session outputs/image2 directory
Stores and uses a configured API key for upstream requests
